name: tls-boundary
title: Check Authorized TLS Boundary
description: Performs one TLS handshake to an explicit authorized host and port, reporting protocol, certificate metadata, and certificate validation state without sending application payloads.

settings.name: host
settings.title: Host
settings.description: One authorized hostname or IP address. No ranges, lists, or wildcards.

settings.name: server_name
settings.title: TLS Server Name
settings.description: Optional SNI/hostname used for the handshake. Defaults to host when host is a name.

settings.name: authorized_target
settings.title: Authorized Target
settings.description: Confirm this target is yours or you are permitted to test.

settings.name: expect_reachable
settings.title: Expected Reachability
settings.description: Optional assertion for whether a TLS connection should be reachable.

settings.name: expect_authorized
settings.title: Expected Certificate Authorization
settings.description: Optional assertion for whether Node should validate the peer certificate.

settings.name: timeout_ms
settings.title: Timeout (ms)
settings.description: Optional connection timeout from 250 to 15000 milliseconds.
